* Identify new customers, dealers, channel partners, system integrators, ISPs, and enterprise accounts.
* Manage existing customers and generate repeat business.
* Drive upselling, cross\-selling, and new product sales.
* Maintain sales pipeline, follow\-ups, quotations, order status, and closure reports.
* Ensure timely customer communication and deal closure.

**2\. Channel Partner and Dealer Management**

* Appoint, develop, and manage channel partners, resellers, dealers, and system integrators.
* Build strong relationships with ISP, telecom, IT networking, and enterprise customers.
* Conduct partner engagement activities, product discussions, and sales follow\-ups.
* Support partners with product information, pricing, availability, and schemes.
* Resolve partner issues related to pricing, delivery, stock, credit, payment, and support.
* Ensure partners follow company sales process and credit policy.

**3\. Product and Brand Knowledge**

* Maintain strong understanding of networking and telecom products.
* Understand product\-wise and model\-wise selling points.
* Coordinate with the technical team for product selection, compatibility, and customer queries.
* Promote company key brands and product categories.
* Understand pricing source, margin, stock availability, and competitor pricing.
* Participate in product training and ensure team knowledge improvement.

**4\. Team Management**

* Lead, guide, and monitor the sales team.
* Set daily, weekly, and monthly targets for team members.
* Review daily activity reports, customer follow\-ups, quotations, and closures.
* Ensure proper CRM/reporting discipline and timely updates from team members.
* Train team members on customer handling, product knowledge, communication, and closure.
* Conduct regular sales reviews and performance discussions.

**5\. Business Development**

* Identify new markets, customer segments, and business opportunities.
* Build business in ISP, telecom, enterprise, system integration, and networking markets.
* Work closely with OEMs for product promotion, schemes, and business growth.
* Lead high\-value deal discussions, pricing negotiation, and closure.
* Track competitor activities and market trends.
* Support expansion of business in assigned territory.

**6\. Coordination and Order Closure**

* Coordinate with Sales Support, Technical Support, Accounts, Operations, Logistics, and Store teams.
* Ensure smooth order processing from quotation to delivery.
* Follow up for payment, credit approval, dispatch, invoice, and customer confirmation.
* Ensure proper closure of every task and customer requirement.
* Avoid pending work without ownership and timeline.
* Maintain email documentation for important discussions, commitments, approvals, and reports.

**7\. Payment Collection and Compliance**

* Follow company credit policy and payment terms.
* Ensure timely payment collection from customers and channel partners.
* Monitor outstanding payments and receivables.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for overdue payment follow\-up.
* Ensure compliance with company code of conduct, HR policies, and POSH guidelines.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong B2B sales and channel sales experience.
* Good knowledge of IT networking, wireless, telecom, ISP, VoIP, routers, switches, access points, and fiber products.
* Experience in dealer/distributor/channel partner handling.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to handle targets and work under pressure.
* Good customer relationship management skills.
* Team handling and leadership ability.
* Good coordination with internal departments.
* Strong follow\-up and closure approach.
* Basic knowledge of CRM, Excel, email communication, and MIS reporting.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.

**Preferred Product Knowledge**

* MikroTik, Cambium Networks, Mimosa, Grandstream, Ubiquiti, TP\-Link, Cisco, Juniper, Digisol, Optitera, AirPro or similar brands.
* Wireless access points, routers, switches, VoIP/IP phones, fiber networking products, ISP and telecom solutions.
* Basic understanding of Wi\-Fi, wireless, switching, routing, VLAN, Cisco switches/routers, and related networking solutions.

**Qualification**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management will be preferred.
* Engineering or technical background will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 5 to 8 years of experience in B2B sales.
* Experience in IT networking, telecom, ISP, wireless, or enterprise sales preferred.
* Minimum 2 to 3 years of team handling or senior sales responsibility preferred.
* Experience with channel partners, system integrators, OEMs, and distributors will be an advantage.

* Ensure timely execution of customer orders and deliveries.
* Provide market feedback to assist in production planning and product development.

* **Present sales performance, market trends, and business forecasts to senior management.**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Metallurgy, Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial) or Business Administration.

* Proven experience in selling ferro alloys such as SiMn, FeMn, FeCr, and FeNi.
* Experience in domestic and export sales is preferred.
* Strong network within steel plants, foundries, stainless steel manufacturers, and alloy producers.

* Strong business development and sales negotiation skills.
* Excellent knowledge of the ferro alloy and steel industry.
* Customer relationship management.
* Market research and competitive analysis.
* Commercial negotiation and contract management.
* Export documentation and international trade knowledge.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic Thinking
* Business Acumen
* Customer Focus
* Negotiation \& Influencing Skills
* Relationship Building
* Result Orientation
* Commercial Awareness
* Leadership \& Team Collaboration
* Analytical Thinking
* Problem Solving

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Achievement of sales and revenue targets.
* New customer acquisition.
* Market share growth.
* Customer retention rate.
* Gross margin and profitability.
* Export business growth.
* Sales pipeline conversion ratio.
* Collection efficiency and outstanding receivables.
* Customer satisfaction index.
* On\-time order execution.

Candidates with experience in:

* Stainless Steel Industry
* Mining \& Minerals
